card: Switches format string parameters in BaseIndex::FatalErrorf and LogConnectFailure from util::ConstevalFormatString to util::log::FormatString. This enforces compile-time checks preventing redundant trailing newlines that would otherwise be rendered as escaped \x0a sequences in log files. The author notes this continues cleanup from PR 36397.
changed_since_previous: Now includes the complete patch for the single commit; the approach and touched call sites are unchanged.
evidence: PR description: "Both functions format a message that is ultimately logged, so it must not contain a redundant trailing newline. Otherwise, it could lead to escaped \x0a inside log messages. This continues https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36397"
problem: Functions that format strings for logging without using util::log::FormatString can accept trailing newlines, which causes logging sanitization to output escaped \x0a characters.

risk.why: A mistake in format string types would fail at compile time and carries no runtime or consensus risk.

summary: Replaces util::ConstevalFormatString with util::log::FormatString in BaseIndex::FatalErrorf and LogConnectFailure. This enables compile-time verification that format strings passed to these logging helper functions do not contain redundant trailing newlines.
